output.incidentTitle: Auto-remediated Revenue Loss: Roku Impression Beacon Failure in us-east
output.postmortem: Incident ID inc-1788114899952 started at 2026-08-30T18:34:59.952Z. TIMELINE: At 18:34Z, a 50% impression loss was detected for the Roku device class, triggering an automated investigation and remediation. ROOT CAUSE: Client-side impression beacons from Roku devices were failing to fire, while ad delivery and fill remained healthy (Failure Class F07). EVIDENCE: Key metrics supported the diagnosis: impression_gap_affected=0.5, impression_gap_others=0, ads_nofill_rate=0, and cdn_5xx=0. Other failure classes were ruled out. ACTION TAKEN: The automated runbook 'rb-beacon-fallback' was executed, patching the SSAI configuration to switch Roku devices to server-side beaconing via a POST to /admin/beacon-mode. VERIFICATION: The action was successful, confirmed by a return to a 0% residual impression gap for the affected device class and a final recovery status of 'true'.
output.cfoBrief: A technical fault put 50% of ad revenue from our Roku user base on the sports-1 channel at risk. An automated system detected and corrected the issue. We experienced a quantified, unrecoverable loss of $5.70 before the automated fix was applied. The system fully restored the at-risk revenue stream, preventing all further losses from this incident.
